content: Create web-dashboard directory structure at .claude/web-dashboard/ with server/ and client/ subdirectories
Create backend package.json with Express, Socket.io, CORS, Helmet, Compression, Winston, and Chokidar dependencies
Implement server/index.js: Express server with Socket.io, authentication middleware, rate limiting, CORS, Helmet, compression, and error handling

Create server/routes/api.js with REST endpoints: GET /api/todos, GET /api/metrics/session/:id, GET /api/metrics/daily, GET /api/agents, GET /api/workspaces, POST /api/workspace/switch, GET /api/health
Implement server/websocket.js: WebSocket handler for real-time todo updates, agent status broadcasts, metrics streaming, and log streaming
Create frontend client/package.json with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Socket.io-client, React Query, Zustand, and Framer Motion dependencies
Configure TypeScript (tsconfig.json) and Tailwind CSS (tailwind.config.js) for the React frontend
Create client/src/App.tsx: Main application with routing, navigation, dark/light theme toggle, and responsive layout
Implement client/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard with todo list (real-time updates), agent status cards, metrics overview, and quick actions
Implement client/src/pages/Metrics.tsx: Metrics page with beautiful Recharts visualizations, session history, agent performance comparisons, success rate trends, and interactive filters
Implement client/src/pages/Agents.tsx: Agents page with agent cards showing details, invocation history, success/failure stats, and agent comparison tool
Implement client/src/pages/Workspaces.tsx: Workspace management page with workspace switcher, create new workspace, workspace settings, and import/export functionality
Create client/src/components/TodoCard.tsx: Reusable todo card component with status indicators, animations, and actions
Create client/src/components/AgentCard.tsx: Reusable agent card component with stats, status, and visual indicators
Create client/src/components/MetricsChart.tsx: Reusable chart component using Recharts with responsive design and interactive features
Create client/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts: Custom React hook for WebSocket connection, real-time updates, reconnection logic, and event handling
Create client/src/hooks/useMetrics.ts: Custom React hook for fetching and managing metrics data with caching and real-time updates
Create docker-compose.yml for easy deployment of both backend and frontend services with proper networking and environment configuration
Create comprehensive README.md with setup instructions, architecture overview, API documentation, development guide, and deployment instructions
